remarks: Set on a quiet cul-de-sac with a neighbourhood park at the end of the block, this 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath two-storey fills with natural light from its south-facing back. The main floor features a bright living room open to the dining area and a big country kitchen with plenty of counter space, a bay window breakfast nook and windows overlooking the sunny south yard. A 2-piece bath completes the main level. Upstairs, the primary bedroom offers a walk-in closet and 4-piece ensuite, along with two more good-sized bedrooms and a 4-piece main bath. The unspoiled basement is ready for your own plans. Outside, the fully landscaped, private backyard has a south-facing deck that gets the afternoon sun. Close to walking trails, shopping and everyday amenities. HOA:The HOA maintains shared Hamptons South East features: fencing, landscaping, entry features and other designated amenities. It's a neighbourhood beautification HOA, not a condo corp, so no building insurance, reserve fund or exterior maintenance on the house. (id:67522)
